structured_output.rationale: Lines 1 and 3 (97110) denied CO-236 + N20 — NCCI PTP edit, bundled into 97760 (Column One). Chart documents distinct body regions and separate sessions. awaiting_human.question: What is the Correct Coding Modifier Indicator (CCMI) for the 97110/97760 code pair in the CMS NCCI PTP edit file for Q2 2026 (DOS 2026-06-02)?
